verdict.rationale: This axis applies to Glama, an MCP directory, hosting and gateway platform. Nothing in the evidence shows the Gateway exposing meta-tools that let an agent search for and load tools at runtime instead of receiving full tool definitions. The REST directory search API, the gateway's per-tool enable/disable controls and the browser inspector are adjacent developer building blocks or controls, not runtime meta-tool discovery for agents.

support.subject: As an AI agent, I can search and load tools at runtime through meta-tools instead of having thousands of tool definitions stuffed into my context
